from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError,URLError
import json
urls={
 "vps_observer_cursor":"https://api.github.com/repos/martaxi-boss/VPS/actions/workflows/cloud-supervisor-observation.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=1",
 "project_pulls":"https://api.github.com/repos/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex/pulls?state=all&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=2",
 "project_checks":"https://api.github.com/repos/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex/commits/019b1bd8aa58ebc2da37d33ae161d1de7bbe7b85/check-runs?per_page=2",
}
for name,url in urls.items():
 try:
  req=Request(url,headers={"Accept":"application/vnd.github+json","User-Agent":"Existing-Passive-Observer-Check"})
  with urlopen(req,timeout=20) as res:
   obj=json.loads(res.read(1000000))
   count=len(obj) if isinstance(obj,list) else len(obj.get("workflow_runs",obj.get("check_runs",[])))
   print("%s_HTTP=%d COUNT=%d"%(name,res.status,count))
 except HTTPError as e:
  print("%s_HTTP=%d"%(name,e.code))
 except (URLError,TimeoutError,ValueError) as e:
  print("%s_HTTP=NETWORK_ERROR"%name)
print("ANONYMOUS_GITHUB_CAPABILITY_CHECK_COMPLETE")
PY
